# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 56 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 40 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_056_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 56

**1** Jesus said: "Whoever has come to know the world has found a corpse, and whoever has found a corpse — the world is not worthy of him."

---

**Translation Notes (LOGOS):**
- "Come to know" — gnosis of the world; the full knowledge of what it is
- "Corpse" — the world is not merely inadequate but dead; no life in it
- "The world is not worthy of him" — the knowing one surpasses the world in value
- The saying creates a paradox: by knowing the world fully (as dead), one escapes the world's hold
